correctness.rationale: For an equilateral distance-four named base, valid Katetov vectors are exactly \(\{2,3,4\}^n\) together with n sets of size \(2^{n-1}\) having one exceptional 1. Unit-distance feasibility is the coordinatewise difference-at-most-one predicate. The core block \(D=T^{\otimes n}\), det(T)=-1, has integer inverse; the exceptional block is the direct sum of n all-ones blocks. Each cross row contains the factor \(e=(1,0,0)\), and \(eT^{-1}\) annihilates e,(1,1,1),(0,1,1); hence \(HD^{-1}H^{\mathsf T}\)=0 entrywise by tensor multiplication. An explicit block triangular unimodular integer congruence therefore gives the Smith form and real inertia for all n. The package checker independently reconstructs triangle-valid vectors, all entries, exact Schur cancellation and modular ranks at n=1,2,3,4; its VERIFY_OK is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A full all-size integral congruence resolves the natural arithmetic compatibility invariant rather than a small sample or arbitrary slice. It isolates a \(3^n\) unimodular principal core, n additional rank-one classes, explicit integral null directions, field-independent rank, and signature n+1 in a type matrix indexed by \(3^n+n2^{n-1}\) types. The cancellation of the cross interaction under a nontrivial integer inverse explains these facts structurally, is not supplied by scalar one-type census results, and gives a reusable obstruction-free example for comparisons across distance alphabets. No broad paper-scale consequence is assumed.
